nodes.label: Project Structure (models/services/cli/settings)
nodes.rationale: Data models live in bochord.models; business logic in bochord.services; CLI only in bochord.cli; settings only via pydantic-settings in bochord/settings.py, never os.environ.

nodes.label: ExtractionOrchestrator
nodes.rationale: Reference pattern for per-run orchestration plus RunStats accumulator driving stateless collaborators like DdlExtractor.

nodes.label: Single Responsibility Service Architecture
nodes.rationale: Prefer cohesive classes, constructor injection, methods ≤60 lines, thin public facade, isolate mutable run state in one orchestrator/accumulator.

nodes.label: Napoleon Documentation Contract
nodes.rationale: Class/method docstrings with only applicable Napoleon sections; #: comments on attributes; enforced by make napoleon-gate.

nodes.label: botocraft AWS Preference
nodes.rationale: Prefer botocraft models/managers; if unsupported, stop and ask whether to extend botocraft or use boto3.
